description: Use this when a person asks whether their health insurance can be used at The Wellness, or wants a doctor their insurer recognises. Takes the insurer's name only. Returns whether the clinic is recognised by that insurer, what the person needs to hand and whether authorisation is needed first. Never ask for a membership number, a policy number or a date of birth. Those are entered on The Wellness page.

city.description: Where the person wants to be seen. Leave it out to use where they are, or London.

insurer.description: The insurer's name, e.g. Aviva, Bupa, AXA Health, Allianz.

service.description: Optional service key, if the person has chosen one.

name: check_cover
title: Check insurance
